headline: Pooled directional-concordance claim on the locked n=25 gel<->TFS panel (prior receipt: Spearman rho=0.5667572791, p=0.0018, 'HOLDS') is REFUTED as an undisclosed-heterogeneity claim: stratified on the dataset's own `phr`-presence field (16 rows with phr vs 9 rows without, the latter a contiguous tail block), the with-phr stratum shows strong concordance (rho=0.7428, p=0.0013) while the without-phr stratum is statistically indistinguishable from zero concordance (rho=0.2204, p=0.5729). The pooled 'HOLDS on the panel' framing masks that ~36% of the panel (9/25 systems) carries no detectable gel<->TFS directional relationship at the module's own p<0.05 threshold. Duplicate-row and leave-one-out robustness checks (G2, G3) do NOT independently break the pooled claim -- both remain significant -- so this is specifically a stratified-disclosure refutation, not a pooled-arithmetic refutation.
non_circularity: The stratification variable (`phr` null vs populated) is a field already present in the locked dataset row schema; it was not fitted, learned, or tuned to produce this split -- it is read directly off each row. No quantity here is fitted to the module's signed Arrhenius KPI or any other prior receipt's estimates.
